children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 13, 2026) - Bravada Gold Corporation
(OTCQB: BGAVF) ("Bravada" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that its common shares have recommenced trading on the OTCQB® Venture Market in the United States under the symbol
The OTCQB listing provides U.S. investors with a convenient and transparent trading platform for Bravada shares and complements the Company's primary listing on the TSX Venture Exchange.
"We are pleased to have our OTCQB trading reinstated at an important time in Bravada's evolution,"
said Dr. Paul West-Sells, President and CEO of Bravada Gold.

"With our drill program finishing up, the Company advancing the Wind Mountain Gold-Silver Project toward a Pre-Feasibility Study, and a number of other catalysts anticipated in the next 12 months, we believe improved access to U.S. investors is particularly timely."

OTCQB is a U.S. venture market operated by OTC Markets Group for entrepreneurial and development-stage companies. Trading on the OTCQB provides investors with access to real-time market information and facilitates trading in U.S. dollars.
Bravada to Present at Precious Metals & Critical Minerals Virtual Investor Conference

Paul West-Sells will be presenting live at the Precious Metals & Critical Minerals Virtual Investor Conference hosted by VirtualInvestorConferences.com later today! The presentation will cover the recently released Preliminary Economic Assessment for Wind Mountain and the Company's next steps. The event is open to all investors and registration is free.

Bravada Gold Corporation is a Nevada-focused gold development company advancing its 100%-owned Wind Mountain Gold-Silver Project towards production, supported by a portfolio of exploration and royalty properties across Nevada's premier gold trends.

Wind Mountain offers a rare brownfield development opportunity, having previously operated as a permitted heap-leach gold-silver mine. Existing pits, haul roads, waste dumps, power infrastructure and road access provide a significant head start, reducing the capital, permitting and execution risks typically associated with developing a new mine.

The Wind Mountain 2026 PEA delivered an after-tax NPV (5%) of US$415 million (C$593 million), and a 60% IRR, based on US$3,600/oz gold. With a low strip ratio, conventional heap-leach processing and established infrastructure, the project offers a compelling pathway toward near-term production in mining-friendly Nevada.
On behalf of the Board of Directors
